relationships.subject: inflammatory pain
relationships.evidence_quote: Perisomatic and punctate expression of GluD1 was reduced in the inflammatory pain model

relationships.subject: GluD1 downregulation
relationships.evidence_quote: GluD1 downregulation was associated with an upregulation of AMPA receptor GluA1 subunit in the CFA and SNL models

relationships.subject: Cbln1
relationships.evidence_quote: Bilateral injection of recombinant Cbln1 into the CeA mitigated mechanical hypersensitivity induced by CFA

relationships.subject: D-serine
relationships.evidence_quote: When administered together with Cbln1, we found that D-serine prevented the reduction in mechanical hypersensitivity by recombinant Cbln1

relationships.subject: GluD1
relationships.evidence_quote: We found GluD1 elements on the cell soma in close apposition with CGRP elements and 3D reconstruction suggested the localization of CGRP to be presynaptic

key_findings: GluD1 and Cbln1 are downregulated in right central amygdala in inflammatory and neuropathic pain while GluA1 is upregulated; recombinant Cbln1 reverses this and pain behaviors in a GluD1-dependent manner.
GluD1 localizes postsynaptically at PB-CGRP synapses on PKCδ+ neurons, not SOM neurons.
